Content: Very easy to install! Better than trying to hardwire dash cams with their hardware kits which requires messing with fuses.

I got this in the nick of time. I wanted my dash cam to be able to record while I was on a trip. And it was a good thing that I did. while my car was at the airport parking I got struck by an other vehicle and my dash cam came on and recorded the license plate and drive. Needless to say, justice was served. Works as described.
Don't have a 'cigarette lighter' or 12V accessory outlet?  This connects directly to your OBD panel.  Recommended
